tasks.title: Create BYOK Credential Management System
tasks.description: Implement secure storage and management for user-provided API keys across multiple providers
tasks.details:
✅ COMPLETED: Comprehensive BYOK Credential Management System has been successfully implemented with zero-knowledge architecture. The system includes:

**Core Infrastructure (✅ Complete):**
- Credential manager with secure storage, validation, and encryption services
- Zero-knowledge vault ensuring keys never leave user's machine unencrypted
- Automatic memory clearing and session-based caching
- Comprehensive audit logging without exposing sensitive data

**Platform Integration (✅ Complete):**
- Windows Credential Manager native implementation
- macOS Keychain native implementation  
- Linux Secret Service native implementation
- Environment variable fallbacks

**Security Features (✅ Complete):**
- Secure transmission protocols for API calls
- Automatic key sanitization
- Keys never logged or transmitted in plain text
- Session-based secure caching

**Provider Support (✅ Complete):**
- Built-in validators for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Azure, and AWS
- Automatic key rotation reminders
- Invalid key handling with user feedback

**Integration (✅ Complete):**
- Seamless integration with existing orchestration provider adapters
- UI for API key management in settings

The system maintains a zero-knowledge architecture where API keys are encrypted locally and never transmitted or stored in plain text.

tasks.title: Implement Context Caching System
tasks.description: Build advanced caching system supporting provider-specific context caching APIs
tasks.details:
COMPLETED: Implemented a comprehensive context caching system for the orchestration engine with the following features:

1. **Provider-Specific Adapters**: Created adapters for Anthropic (beta context caching), Google Gemini (1-hour persistence), and OpenAI (response caching)

2. **Storage Backends**: Implemented both in-memory (with LRU eviction) and Redis-based distributed storage

3. **Semantic Caching**: Added embedding-based similarity matching for intelligent cache retrieval across similar queries

4. **Cache Management**: Built comprehensive invalidation, warming, and monitoring capabilities

5. **Performance Monitoring**: Created real-time monitoring with configurable alerts for hit rate, eviction rate, and errors

6. **Integration**: Seamlessly integrated with the orchestration engine to automatically cache contexts based on provider and cost thresholds

The system significantly reduces costs by caching expensive API calls and improves performance by avoiding redundant requests.
tasks.testStrategy: COMPLETED: Comprehensive testing implemented including cache hit rates across providers, cost reduction metrics verification, cache invalidation accuracy testing, performance benchmarking of cache operations, and cross-provider cache compatibility testing.

tasks.description: Build optional Docker compose configuration for full infrastructure deployment
tasks.details: Create Docker compose files for all services (Neo4j, Qdrant, Redis, Mem0, RabbitMQ, Langfuse). Build auto-provisioning system for Pro tier. Implement health monitoring and auto-recovery. Add resource optimization and scaling. Create backup and restore functionality. Build migration tools for updates.
tasks.testStrategy: Test one-click deployment on various systems. Verify all services start correctly and communicate. Test auto-recovery scenarios. Performance test under load. Backup and restore verification.

tasks.title: Implement RBAC and Monetization System
tasks.description: Build flexible role-based access control and feature flagging for monetization without artificial limits
tasks.details: Create RBAC system with granular permissions. Build feature flagging system for tier management. Implement dynamic feature control without code changes. Create admin dashboard for configuration. Add usage tracking and analytics. Build license verification system. Implement graceful degradation for missing services.
tasks.testStrategy: Test permission enforcement across all features. Verify feature flags work correctly. Test tier transitions and upgrades. Admin dashboard functionality testing. License verification and expiration testing.

tasks.title: Build Langfuse Observability Integration
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive LLM observability for monitoring multi-model performance and costs
tasks.details: Integrate Langfuse SDK for request tracking. Build custom dashboards for multi-model analytics. Implement cost attribution by user/team/project. Create A/B testing framework for model comparison. Add agent performance tracking for Hivemind. Build alerting for anomalies. Export capabilities for compliance.
tasks.testStrategy: Test data collection completeness. Verify cost tracking accuracy. Test A/B testing framework functionality. Dashboard performance under high volume. Alert triggering accuracy testing.

tasks.title: Create Knowledge Base System
tasks.description: Build automatic documentation generation and intelligent knowledge base for projects
tasks.details: Implement automatic knowledge base construction from code. Build multi-language dependency analysis. Create documentation crawler and indexer. Implement version-specific documentation mapping. Build intelligent Q&A system. Add migration assistance features. Create knowledge sharing across projects.
tasks.testStrategy: Test knowledge extraction accuracy. Verify dependency analysis correctness. Test documentation relevance ranking. Q&A accuracy testing. Cross-project knowledge sharing validation.

tasks.title: Build Production Deployment System
tasks.description: Create enterprise-ready deployment options including SaaS, hybrid, and air-gapped configurations
tasks.details: Build Kubernetes deployment templates. Implement multi-region deployment for SaaS. Create hybrid deployment with secure tunnels. Build air-gapped deployment packages. Implement auto-scaling and load balancing. Add comprehensive monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana. Create disaster recovery procedures.
tasks.testStrategy: Test deployments in all three modes. Verify auto-scaling under load. Test failover and disaster recovery. Security audit of all deployment modes. Performance testing at scale.
